scenario_outline: Authenticate and enforce role plus event relationship; reject unrelated organiser and attendee access
Submit a valid event request; reject missing required fields without partial submission
Save incomplete draft and reopen it; preserve draft distinction and ownership
Review then request clarification or approve/reject; verify relevant users see the decision
Assign and reassign coordinator; enforce agreed authority and updated relationship access
Apply legal transitions and reject illegal transitions without changing state
Apply ordinary edit and protect changes affecting existing arrangements
Read venue planning information and enforce catalogue management permissions
Show bookings and blocked periods across relevant date boundaries
Combine timing and venue requirement filters; handle no suitable match
Check capacity boundary and required facilities/layout/accessibility using agreed rules
Create booking request containing current event timing and requirements
Approve or reject booking and show relevant decision information
Competing overlapping approvals cannot double-book; verify agreed adjacent-interval rule
Record equipment type quantity and technical needs; process request as technical staff
Exclude committed and unavailable equipment for the requested interval
Competing reservations cannot exceed available quantity; retain event association
Register and withdraw under agreed eligibility/capacity rules; enforce management visibility
Review significant event change and consistently reconsider affected arrangements
Deliver relevant action notifications to correct recipients without unrelated data exposure
